Android sideload — offline language classroom (v0.3.3)

Download Boriken-Learner.apk

If the button fails, use the GitHub link below, or open this page from Files after saving it.

Install steps (phone)

  1. Tap Download above (or the raw GitHub link).
  2. If Chrome says “blocked for safety”, tap Download anyway / Details → Keep.
  3. Open Settings → Apps → Special app access → Install unknown apps → allow Chrome or Files.
  4. Open Downloads → tap Boriken-Learner.apk → Install → Open.

If it still won’t download

  • Open this direct file link in Chrome:
    raw.githubusercontent.com … /Boriken-Learner.apk
  • Or download from the Cursor agent Artifacts panel: Boriken-Learner.apk
  • Or transfer the APK over USB / Drive / Nearby Share, then open it in Files.

If it installs but won’t open / blank screen

  1. Uninstall any old Borikén app.
  2. Install v0.3.3 (this build uses a fixed WebView loader).
  3. You should see a short toast: “Borikén offline — classroom ready”.

Package ID: com.boriken.learner · Android 7.0+
